links.repo_excerpt: Official source code of FreeCAD, a free and opensource multiplatform 3D parametric modeler.
links.mechanism: FreeCAD provides open-source 3D parametric computer-aided design modeling and basic Building Information Modeling (BIM) drafting modules that broadly align with the geometric modeling requirements of facility design for the operating building.
links.limitation: Complex medical architecture requires certified DIN 13080 hospital functional space mapping and specialized engineering compliance tools not present in baseline FreeCAD, and the procurement calls for professional architectural planning services rather than standalone geometric software.
links.next_check: Evaluate FreeCAD BIM/Arch workbench documentation to verify whether it can natively import and validate German clinical facility IFC4 spatial classification profiles.
